content.text: I see, so you've identified a logic error. Is that right?

Yes—a logic error in how approval was saved.

The code treated one approval as several independently committed writes. If a later write failed, earlier changes remained saved, leaving inconsistent state. Concurrent approvals could also create duplicates.

I reproduced the failure in a test. I haven’t established that it caused an incident in your live database.
